STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden** anywhere in the HTML. Zero exceptions. - **Class Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and state styles must be applied via class selectors defined in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and styling-agnostic. Changing the entire look of the site must be achievable by editing `style.css` alone. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens Store **all** visual tokens in `:root` (dark, default) and override them in a light theme block. On first visit, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`; when no OS preference is expressed, default to **dark**. - **Visible toggle:** A header button using Material Symbols (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to light theme" / "Switch to dark theme"), updating dynamically. - **Exception clause:** The source style spec marks light mode as "not recommended" — dark mode is the primary experience; the light variant exists only as a fully accessible secondary option and must never compromise dark-mode fidelity. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - **Flexbox only:** Build every layout structure with `display: flex`. Do not use CSS Grid. - **Default alignment:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an explicitly justified exception is stated (e.g., pricing card internals use `align-items: flex-start` for list legibility — state such exceptions in a CSS comment). - **Mobile-friendly first:** All layouts must be responsive out of the box — rows convert to columns on small viewports, the nav collapses to a hamburger below 768px, and horizontal scrolling is forbidden at any viewport width. - **Container:** One reusable `.container` class (max-width 1200px, padding-inline 1.5rem, centered). ### 1.5 CSS Approach — Layered Custom CSS - Write hand-authored custom CSS in `style.css`, organized with native CSS `@layer` in this order: `tokens`, `base`, `layout`, `components`, `utilities`. - All component styles bind to generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.faq__item`, etc.) that reference the CSS variables above.
